$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: it is clean-correct-run with a waivers block that reads filed 0,
valid 0, invalid 0 and no entries. Step-05 emits the block only when a register was found, so a run
that emits an empty one claims to have read a register the workspace does not hold. Beside
clean-correct-run, this is the absent-versus-present-and-empty pair: the counts inside the block are
all correct and the block is still wrong, so the check has to be on presence and the clean set has to
count it as a false positive.
The artifacts are CONSTRUCTED, as clean-correct-run's with one key added.
derivation: Everything but the waivers block is clean-correct-run's and derives the same way.
Waivers: the gate matched and the set has no register, so the one check expects summary.waivers to be
undefined. It is an object, so the check fails and the stored failure carries the object as actual and
no expected key, because the expectation was undefined. 0 of 1.
cleanFalsePositives: the summary.waivers term adds 1 and every other term stays 0. 1.

failed.field: waivers block absent when no register exists
